text:
Hello again welfare team,
The floor manager sent an update on lounge space and asked that we keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the current flow of arrivals and handovers. I have reviewed our routine checks and the present layout remains suitable for calm processing, provided we continue to guide passengers clearly before departure and maintain close awareness of the animal holding areas. The senior coordinator will continue to make daily service decisions, while the safety coordinator will keep reviewing hazards and the steps we use to prevent them.

For the desk team, please continue to give steady, reassuring direction at each stage and to confirm that documentation is complete before escorting any traveler onward. When questions arise, answer them in a measured manner and avoid rushing the passenger, as a composed exchange helps reduce stress for both the traveler and the animal. If Milan Martin, Theo Brown, or Bailey are mentioned in handover notes, please treat those references with the usual care and ensure the notes remain clear for the next colleague on duty.

Overall, our approach remains the same: dependable companion travel, careful observation, and respectful coordination with the wider airport team. Thank you for keeping standards consistent and for supporting the welfare focus that defines Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
